🛒 Steam's first-ever Black Friday format is back — but with a twist this year!

📅 Steam Black Friday 2026 runs November 26-30 (10am Pacific / 1pm Eastern / 6pm UK start & end).
🏷️ Unlike 2025's storewide event, Valve isn't running this one directly — individual publishers set their own discounts, and the usual 30-day discount cooldown still applies (only Seasonal Sales like Winter Sale are exempt).
🏆 It overlaps with Steam Awards 2026 nominations, which just opened today for the awards' 10th anniversary.
❄️ Winter Sale is already locked in for Dec 17 - Jan 4.

🕐 Posted: 00:03 GMT+3

📰 Sources: Valve/Steamworks (via Digital Citizen)
👥 x.com/Steam

💬 What's on your Steam wishlist waiting for a discount? Tell us below!

#Steam #BlackFriday #PCGaming #SteamSale #GamingNews
